visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized presentation of a finished shredded tofu skin salad on a white plate with blue French script. The salad is a colorful mix of pale tofu strips, orange carrots, green celery, and dark mushrooms, garnished with cilantro. The background shows a tidy kitchen with a red pot on a black stovetop and a white mug, all under bright, even lighting. (2) Hands appear over a yellow cutting board, using a chef's knife to slice stalks of light green celery into segments. The camera focus is sharp on the cutting action and the texture of the vegetables. (3) The same hands are seen julienning dark, rehydrated wood ear mushrooms on the yellow board, demonstrating careful knife skills. (4) A close-up shows the hands slicing a fresh green cucumber into thin diagonal rounds, then stacking them to cut into fine julienne strips. (5) A hand uses a metal julienne peeler to shred a bright orange carrot directly onto a light blue scalloped plate, creating long, thin strips. (6) A light blue tray is shown holding the prepared piles of shredded carrots, celery segments, and wood ear mushroom strips separately. (7) A person's hand holds a large bundle of pale yellow, thin shredded tofu skin over a stainless steel strainer, highlighting its texture. (8) In a bright kitchen, a red pot of water boils on the stove. A wooden spoon adds white salt to the water, followed by the addition of the dark wood ear mushroom strips. (9) The chopped celery and shredded carrots are added to the boiling water with the mushrooms. Wooden chopsticks are used to briefly stir the vegetables. (10) The blanched vegetables are scooped out with a metal strainer and placed into a large metal bowl to drain and cool. (11) The shredded tofu skin is added to the boiling water, stirred for a few seconds, then immediately strained and transferred into a bowl of cool water to maintain its texture. (12) The cooled tofu skin is drained in a strainer, squeezed by hand to remove excess moisture, and then cut with black kitchen scissors into manageable lengths. (13) In a small white ceramic bowl, ingredients for the sauce including oyster sauce, sugar, grated garlic, and vinegar are added and stirred with a wooden spoon until combined into a dark brown liquid. (14) In a large white ceramic mixing bowl, the prepared tofu skin is combined with the blanched vegetables. A hand sprinkles a small amount of white salt and greyish white pepper over the top. (15) The prepared dark sauce is poured over the ingredients in the mixing bowl. A hand wearing a clear plastic glove thoroughly tosses and rubs the ingredients to ensure even coating. (16) Freshly sliced cucumbers and a handful of cilantro are added. The cilantro is trimmed with scissors directly into the bowl. (17) Golden sesame oil is poured over the greens, and the entire mixture is hand-tossed again until the salad is glossy and well-mixed. (18) A final plated serving is shown. A hand squeezes juice from a fresh lime wedge over the salad, followed by a small spoon drizzling red chili oil on top. (19) A woman with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a pink apron, is seen in her kitchen eating the salad with chopsticks. She smiles, chews enthusiastically, and gives a thumbs up to the camera. (20) The video ends with a white CapCut logo and user ID appearing on a solid black background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 簡單又開胃的『涼拌干絲』一吃就上癮🔥😋. (2) [Subtitle]: 準備兩株芹菜切成長段... (3) [Subtitle]: 黑木耳切成絲... (4) [Subtitle]: 小黃瓜先切片. (5) [Subtitle]: 再切成絲... (6) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔用刨絲刀刨成絲. (7) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜的部分，大致上這些(文字食譜請看留言). (8) [Subtitle]: 干絲洗乾淨，瀝乾. (9) [Subtitle]: 煮一鍋水，水裡加入足夠的鹽. (10) [Subtitle]: 水滾後，放入木耳絲. (11) [Subtitle]: 約煮30秒. (12) [Subtitle]: 接著再放入芹菜跟紅蘿蔔絲. (13) [Subtitle]: 約煮10秒. (14) [Subtitle]: 取出，放到網架上. (15) [Subtitle]: 先一旁瀝乾放涼. (16) [Subtitle]: 水滾後，放入干絲. (17) [Subtitle]: 大約煮40秒. (18) [Subtitle]: 取出後，放入冷開水裡降溫. [Variety]: ✅ 這樣干絲才不會脫水變乾吃起來更滑順！❤️. (19) [Subtitle]: 接著瀝乾. (20) [Subtitle]: 可用手再擠乾水分. (21) [Subtitle]: 用簡單剪兩三刀以方便入口... (22) [Subtitle]: 來準備醬料：蠔油、糖、蒜泥、醋. (23) [Subtitle]: 攪拌攪拌... (24) [Subtitle]: 將干絲放到盆子裡. (25) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜放進來. (26) [Subtitle]: 一小撮鹽、一匙白胡椒. (27) [Subtitle]: 所有的醬料... (28) [Subtitle]: 充分的抓揉均勻讓味道吃進去... (29) [Subtitle]: 像這樣... (30) [Subtitle]: 接著放入小黃瓜跟香菜... (31) [Subtitle]: 在香菜上淋上較多的芝麻油充分抓勻. (32) [Subtitle]: 接著再跟其他食材充分拌勻. (33) [Subtitle]: 做完可以直接吃，也可以放入冰箱冷藏後會更好吃喔！！. (34) [Subtitle]: 上桌時，可以擠上一些檸檬汁. [Variety]: 吃起來會更清爽開胃喔❤️. (35) [Subtitle]: 喜歡辣辣的可以淋上自製辣油...😉. (36) [Slogan]: 簡單又開胃的『涼拌干絲』一吃就上癮🔥😋. (37) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉～😉. (38) [Subtitle]: 哇～好好吃干絲很滑順... (39) [Subtitle]: 一吃就上癮🔥. (40) [Variety]: 超好吃 ❤️😉. (41) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen. (42) [Logo]: CapCut.
